text.p: Microsoft Corp. said Friday it earned $741 million in the latest quarter, sharply higher than a year ago, but the software giant warned of slower earnings growth in its next fiscal year.

The earnings, equal to 57 cents a share, compared with net income of $575 million, or 45 cents a share, in the year-ago quarter. The results beat analysts' forecasts. A survey by First Call found that Wall Street analysts expected Microsoft on average to report earnings equal to 51 cents a share for the quarter, with estimates ranging from 47 to 55 cents.
